d: A three-story building has collapsed in Brooklyn's Flatbush neighbourhood, leaving at least one person dead and 10 others injured, including four seriously. One person remains trapped under the rubble as firefighters continue search and rescue operations. The collapse occurred around 4 pm on Wednesday, with emergency responders deploying drones and flashlights to locate victims. Dramatic footage shows firefighters pulling survivors from the debris and searching through the wreckage. A construction site was located next to the collapsed building.
